explanation.explore: 0 accepted flux measurements and 18 rejected measurements. Flux density measures received light per frequency interval; 1 mJy = 10⁻²⁹ W m⁻² Hz⁻¹. These wavelengths were observed at different times, not in a single simultaneous spectrum. No supported blackbody fit: at least six clean positive measurements at S/N ≥ 5 are required.
explanation.research: No supported blackbody fit: at least six clean positive measurements at S/N ≥ 5 are required. The model minimizes Σ[(Fν − A Bν(T))/σ]² on a 500–30000 K grid, with a fitted normalization and a 3% error floor. The Δχ² ≤ 1 interval is scaled by max(χ²ᵣ,1); it is conditional on the model and does not include all calibration systematics. An interval containing only one grid sample is unresolved, not zero uncertainty. Flagged points are displayed but excluded from fitting. Feature markers are illustrative rest wavelengths, not detections or abundances.
